description.p: histcounts2 partitions the (X, Y) pairs into a two-dimensional grid of bins and counts how many pairs fall into each bin.
N(i, j) counts the pairs for which Xedges(i) <= X < Xedges(i+1) and Yedges(j) <= Y < Yedges(j+1). The last bin of each dimension is closed on both ends.

You can supply the number of bins (a scalar, or [nx ny]) or the explicit edge vectors Xedges and Yedges. When a number of bins is requested, the edges are chosen on a 'nice' grid, the same way as histcounts. Pairs with a NaN coordinate are ignored.
